title: A Guide to Navigating Change with EFMP and Community Resources
intro: Navigating military life can be challenging—especially when caring for a family member with special needs. The Exceptional Family Member Program (EFMP) is here to support you every step of the way.

sections.heading: Personalized Support From EFMP
sections.markdown:
EFMP professionals offer personalized guidance to help your family:

* Navigate systems like [Individualized Education Program (IEP)](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/news/be-prepared-for-individualized-education-program-iep) meetings.
* Access resources after a new diagnosis or PCS move.
* Learn how to advocate for your family's unique needs.

You're never alone—EFMP ensures you have support during times of transition.

sections.heading: Respite Care for Caregivers
sections.markdown:
Caretakers need to be taken care of too.

Respite care is a non-entitlement EFMP benefit that provides short-term breaks for primary caregivers of eligible family members. Families select, hire, and pay for their respite care provider and seek reimbursement from EFMP.

sections.heading: Stay Organized with an Educational Binder
sections.markdown:
A family educational binder can ease the stress of school transitions and help your child take ownership of their learning. Keep important documents in one place, including:

* IEPs and 504 plans
* Report cards and transcripts
* Recommendation letters

This simple tool supports academic continuity and empowers your student during relocation and changes in support of needs.

sections.heading: Look for Purple Star Schools
sections.markdown:
Before or during a move, check whether your new school is a [Purple Star School](https://statepolicy.militaryonesource.mil/priorities/purple-star-school-program/2021), a designation that signals strong support for military-connected students. These schools often offer:

* New student orientations
* Student-led events
* Peer-led transition groups

Visit your state's Department of Education website or the school's homepage to confirm Purple Star status.

sections.heading: Youth Sports: Build Social Connection
sections.markdown: Youth Sports programs offer more than physical activity—they help kids form friends, build confidence, and feel part of a new community. Whether on the soccer field or basketball court, children and teens benefit from teamwork, shared goals, and peer support in their new environment.

sections.heading: Plan Ahead for Childcare with MilitaryChildCare.com
sections.markdown:
[MilitaryChildCare.com](https://public.militarychildcare.csd.disa.mil/mcc-central/mcchome) (MCC) is your go-to resource for finding child and youth care services at your next installation. Create an account early to:

* Explore available programs.
* Submit requests before you move.
* Ensure a smooth childcare transition after arrival.
